title: Uninvestment Check
concept: A behavioural scan that tells regulatory withdrawal (needs space, still invested) apart from progressive uninvestment (quietly reducing emotional stake) — with forced routing to the right repair.
whenToUse: Warmth is missing even in neutral time; repairs feel rote; future planning shrinks; contempt replaces frustration.
steps: Score the signs below, independently, then share.
If regulatory withdrawal → Pause + Return hygiene + Micro-Repairs.
If 3 or more uninvestment signs → schedule Full Recovery + Proof. Don't wait.
If contempt, fear, or coercion is present → prioritise safety and outside support.
Define a proof window for reinvestment behaviours.

phrases.text: I'm noticing withdrawal — is this regulation, or are we losing investment?
I need a Full Recovery conversation; hope isn't our plan.
Contempt is a stop sign for business-as-usual.

working: Signs: fewer initiated contacts; logistics-only talk; rote repairs. Couple schedules Full Recovery within a week; sets Proof on daily initiation + Evening Landing for 21 days. Trajectory clarifies.
notWorking: Waiting for “them to miss me” while contempt grows. Hoping instead of scheduling completes the exit ramp.
activity: Independently mark signs present/absent: fewer non-logistical initiations, decreased curiosity, future planning avoided, more solo investment, mostly functional conversations, obligatory affection, rote repairs, contempt replacing frustration. Share marks. If clustered on uninvestment, book a Full Recovery date before leaving the conversation.
warn: Contempt, fear, or coercion present? Prioritise safety and outside support first.
